adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `updateEvent()` now computes `selectedCalendar` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. That `find(...)` branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so it searches for `cal.externalId === undefined` and will typically return `undefined`. Unlike `createEvent()` (which falls back to `"primary"`), `updateEvent()` appears to pass this `selectedCalendar` through to `calendar.events.update(...)` without a fallback, so updates for bookings/references lacking `externalCalendarId` can target `calendarId: undefined` instead of the prior `event.destinationCalendar.externalId`. The same flawed pattern exists in `deleteEvent()`’s `calendarId` computation too.
